reason: Because the signal is formed at the cash close and entry is deliberately delayed by five minutes, same-sign position netting would require modeling the five-minute boundary return. To eliminate that ambiguity before outcome inspection, each observation is treated as an independent round-trip.

frozen_execution.each_observation: Flat before entry; enter at the preregistered +5-minute Mini bar open; exit at the next cash-close Mini bar open; flat immediately after exit.
frozen_execution.primary_cost: 1 Mini tick (5 index points) on entry plus 1 Mini tick on exit.
frozen_execution.stress_cost: 2 Mini ticks (10 index points) on entry plus 2 Mini ticks on exit.
